enchantments.tooltip: +14 Enhancement Bonus: +14 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Fortification +141%: +141% Enhancement bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.
Quality Potency +23: Passive: +23 Quality bonus to each Spell Power.
Sheltering +33: +33 Enhancement bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings
Parrying +6: +6 Insight bonus to Armor Class, +6 Insight bonus to Saves.
Blurry: Equipping this item causes you to become slightly blurry. Attacks from enemies have a 20% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Deathblock: The wearer of this item is immune to all death spells and magical death effects.
Insightful Spell Focus Mastery +3: +3 Insight bonus to the DC of all spells.
Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
